messages:
alex-k: oncall-bot flagged a sustained error-rate increase for hosted-inference (embed/chat) at ~09:12 UTC, >5% 500s for 10m. Pager went out.
oncall-bot: Pager: SEV2 - hosted-inference error-rate spike. Runbook: #inc-bridge and notify oncall. Link: https://redwood/incident/2839456789
maya-r: I'm starting the bridge. taking primary. alex-k can you drop initial customer-impact notes here?
alex-k: affected customers: team-prod keys a7f3, b21d (two enterprise accounts saw 502s in logs). Support tickets inbound. ETA on mitigation: unknown.
jordan-l: from infra side: noticing repeated KV cache eviction + grpc_conn_reset on node pool g4-1. Logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:11:34Z inference: kvcache eviction=1 mem_free=120MB grpc_err=14
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z runtime: worker-2 OOM, restarted
```
sanjay-p: adding observability: pushing flamegraphs and pprof link to bridge. also enabling extra debug logs for the duration.
emily-t: I can shadow a fallback model routing (lower-cost variant) to reduce pressure if you want to try quick mitigation.
maya-r: yes please. emily, route ~10% of prod traffic to text-small-v1 as a canary. monitor latency and error-rate.
luisa-m: looping in support: I will notify the two account SEs and draft a short customer note summarizing impact and ETA.
alex-k: mitigation step 1: reduce batch size and enable kvcache pinning on hot shards. mitigation step 2: canary routing (emily). doing 1 now.
jordan-l: decreased batch max_tokens from 32->8 on pool g4-1; observed immediate drop in OOMs. error-rate down to ~2.1% after 6m.
emily-t: canary routing applied: 12% traffic -> text-small-v1. early metrics show reduced downstream errors but slightly higher latency for those requests.
maya-r: good. marking incident as mitigated for customer impact — ongoing stabilization.
alex-k: next: schedule post-incident review. proposed times: tomorrow 16:00 UTC or Fri 14:00 UTC. owners: maya-r (ops lead), jordan-l (infra), emily-t (model routing), luisa-m (customer comms).
sanjay-p: I'll collect telemetry and hand off artifacts: flamegraphs, pprofs, span traces, and exact node IDs. uploading to /incidents/2839456789/artifacts.
luisa-m: timeline note for RCA: start at 09:08 UTC (first anomalous spike), 09:11 UTC (OOM on worker-2), 09:18 UTC (batch size change), 09:25 UTC (error rate <3%).
emily-t: root causes to investigate: (1) batch sizing heuristic not adapting to memory pressure with new model variant; (2) unbalanced KV cache hot-shard leading to evictions; (3) lack of automatic fallback thresholds on routing.
alex-k: agreed. assign RCA doc draft to jordan-l (timeline & infra), maya-r (mitigation narrative), emily-t (routing/serving suggestions), sanjay-p (evidence/telemetry), luisa-m (customer impact & comms). please put draft in /postmortems/drafts/2839456789-rca.md by EOD tomorrow.
maya-r: I'll own coordinating peer review. ask reviewers: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product-ops. reviewers: @sarah, @diego, @nora if available.
jordan-l: initial draft note: quant-repro step to reproduce in staging: run 500 concurrent short-infer requests with kv-hot-key churn; measure evictions.
emily-t: I'll propose two mitigations in the doc: adaptive batching (limit tokens per GPU dynamically) and shard-aware KV pinning. include perf cost estimates.
luisa-m: comms draft: short apology + impact window 09:08-09:25 UTC, customers affected: 2 enterprise + small fraction of self-serve; action: full RCA + follow-up call offer. sending draft tomorrow.
alex-k: sign-off plan: peer review complete by +48h after draft, leadership sign-off (cto/product) by +72h. tag owners in doc for explicit sign-off lines.
maya-r: noted. I'll create a checklist in the doc: timeline, contributing factors, mitigations, action owners+ETA, detection improvements, customer comms. assigning JIRA tickets after review.
sanjay-p: uploading collected logs now. ping when draft is up and I'll attach raw evidence.
emily-t: once draft is ready I will run a quick regression test of routing fallback in dedicated staging and add results.
luisa-m: thanks everyone. will post customer note after leadership review of the comms paragraph.
alex-k: closing bridge in 10m, keeping this thread as canonical for RCA coordination. :thumbsup:
